mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline periods yield negative 5-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of UNRATE >4.5% consecutive-month periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL >5.0% yoy) triggers aggressive Fed tightening, increasing real rates and depressing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL >5.0% yoy periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth periods yield negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO <95.0 consecutive-month periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal economic slowdown, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns occur in >60% of instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Prolonged industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for three months indicates supply chain disruption, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO <98.0 consecutive-month periods.
